metadata.label: p9-form-regression
metadata.network: HTTP loopback; headless Chromium; no network or CPU throttling

checks: Foreign keys enabled; FK and SQLite integrity checks.
All financial, payment, discount and accepted-term guards remain installed.
Every invoice/line reconciles with accepted prices, exact discounts, exclusive half-up tax, dates and current logical charge.
Every payment cache/count/settlement reconciles with immutable real positive payment inserts; zero Paid has no payment.
All 10k original daily/weekly/monthly/yearly anchors, whole expiry dates, decided prefixes, failed cursors, waivers and indexed projections checked.
Discount usage and real persisted billing run item counts reconcile.

protocol.warm: Hard navigation in reused role context, cached assets after one unrecorded preparation. Timer begins before goto and ends after destination data/controls, fonts.ready and two animation frames.
protocol.cold: One navigation per destination in a new browser context with only authenticated cookies copied. Browser HTTP cache empty; server and OS filesystem caches are not flushed.
protocol.api: Whole HTTP GET through response-body read. First probe after a fresh server process per endpoint, then warm samples; persisted role cookies/session checks included. Normal startup lifecycle processing retained. OS filesystem caches are not flushed.
protocol.action: Setup outside timer; timer includes user action, debounce if applicable, response and ready result with fonts/two frames.
protocol.concurrency: Separate five authenticated browser contexts. Subscription/invoice workloads use permitted destinations; finance workload includes three internal finance reads and two customer role-denial pages. An explicit mixed operational workload uses queue, finance, staff subscriptions and customer records. Not mixed into single-user samples.
protocol.target: Every observed first-usable page/action below 2000 ms; percentile summaries never hide breaches.

inventory.readiness: Customer/plan selectors, commercial dates and create control ready; no draft created.
Customer/plan selectors, commercial dates and create control ready; no draft created.
Template and plan loaded with copied product lines and usable draft fields.
